phi_star_observation.delta_explanation: C3 wrapper helper uses different cell-tile heuristic (mean-pool over T → tile to 8x192) vs anima_dialogue_load.py (4-tile concat doubled). Both are ANIMA-internal cell-derivation heuristics; phi_star formula identical. Observed wrapper phi (~41.87-41.89) sits closer to baseline than BG-A's (~42.12) because tile-replicate produces higher cell-pair self-similarity, dampening the cosine spread. Both are valid substrate readouts; not directly comparable across cell-derivation routes.

honest_c3: C1 SentencePiece path discovery is cache-layout-dependent. _resolve_sp_tokenizer_path walks HF_HOME/hub/models--<id>/snapshots/<sha>/tokenizer_64k_multilingual.model. If repo is loaded via local --model PATH (not HF id), the resolver finds nothing and the helper falls through to hf_hub_download which requires network. Fail-mode is silent unless network is offline.

C2 _SPTokenizerWrap mimics only __call__ with input_ids dict — not the full HF tokenizer interface. _real_forward currently only uses tokenizer(text, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, max_length=512); if any future helper-emit code calls tok.decode / tok.batch_encode_plus / tok.pad_token_id etc, the wrap will AttributeError. Additive contract: keep _SPTokenizerWrap surface narrow.

C3 phi_star delta between wrapper (~41.87-41.89) and BG-A direct invoke (42.1158) is real and stems from divergent cell-derivation heuristics, NOT from the SP fallback (tokenization is byte-identical between the two paths). The wrapper's helper-emit cell-tile (mean(T) → tile up) vs anima_dialogue_load's (mean(T) → 4 tiles concat doubled) produce different cell matrices and thus different mean-pair-cosine values. Future unification would require deciding which cell-mapping is canonical — out of scope for this BG.

C4 AutoTokenizer fallback emits a 100+ line stderr error message (the full Model type list from transformers). Visible noise. Tradeoff: explicit failure surface vs visual clutter. Acceptable per raw#10 (honest C3) — silently swallowing the error would be worse.

C5 SentencePiece fallback engagement is implicit — runs whenever AutoTokenizer raises. If transformers ever ships AutoTokenizer support for CLMv4Config (e.g. via auto_map AutoTokenizer entry in upstream config.json), the wrapper will silently switch back to AutoTokenizer with NO regression test catching the route change. Future-proofing: emit explicit ANIMA_TOKENIZER_ROUTE marker (autotokenizer | sentencepiece) on stdout for downstream observability.
